questions:
Convert the following measurement to the given unit.

Input:
15 millimeters to centimeters

A.text:
To convert **15 millimeters to centimeters**, we use the conversion factor:

$$
1 \text{ centimeter} = 10 \text{ millimeters}
$$

So,

$$
15 \text{ millimeters} = \frac{15}{10} = 1.5 \text{ centimeters}
$$

**Answer:** 1.5 centimeters.
